verdict: NO-SHIP — 2 FAIL, 6 FLAG, 10 PASS. Big wins: the dollhouse cut is real from above (no film, near faces open into the cavity, X-ray OFF restores 'Full height'), the ICC link now returns 1,613 relevant FL titles, the homerun spine reads as parallel colored runs, the effective date prints, the legend gutter no longer erases framing, and schedules collapse to ONE sheet. Two blockers remain: (A1) at eye level from outside every wall still carries the host dot-stipple film and cladding is never visible, because host mode 'down' routes all walls to materials.invisible (a see-through ghost, not hidden); (C5) the schedules sheet now overprints its 41st takeoff row with the red flag list. Coordinator item 8 (per-room 'no floor slab' warning) does not fire at all.

A1.note: HALF FIXED. From a dollhouse pitch the cut is genuinely right: /tmp/r3-a-top.png, /tmp/r3-a-0/2/4.png and the 20x crop /tmp/r3-a-close.png show NO film, camera-side stacks removed, studs + wiring + floors + furniture crisp, and the FAR wall's drywall reading as an opaque light backdrop band. Toggle restore verified: X-ray ON -> host chip 'Low', X-ray OFF -> 'Full height', re-ON -> back (/tmp/r3-a-xrayoff.png vs /tmp/r3-a-xrayon2.png) — the previous wall mode IS restored. STILL BROKEN at eye level: /tmp/r3-low-b.png, /tmp/r3-low-c.png and crops /tmp/r3c-low-dots.png, /tmp/r3c-lowc-facade.png, /tmp/r3c-lowd.png show every wall as a light dot-stipple film with the horizon visible straight through the building, and NO cladding anywhere from outside (the camera-facing exterior stack is culled by design, so from outdoors you see studs plus that wall's own interior drywall). Root cause proven in host source, not in Bones: private-editor editor/packages/viewer/src/systems/wall/wall-cutout.tsx sets hideWall = true for every wall when wallMode === 'down', and 'hidden' walls get materials.invisible, which wall-materials.ts:480 builds via createInvisibleWallMaterial as a dotted see-through ghost. The host has no mode that truly removes the shell, so forcing 'down' trades 'film over studs' for 'film over everything'. Repro: fresh clone, open panel, X-ray on, orbit to pitch < 15 deg (right-drag down 90 px), no zoom.

A2.note: Now that faces actually open, the swap is correct: over 4 quarter turns (/tmp/r3-a-0..4.png) the open cavity follows the camera and the previously open side closes back to a drywall backdrop; motion is smooth, no popping lag, no one-frame flash of the old cut.

A3.note: Unchanged from rounds 1-2: injected tree between camera and house occludes the skeleton (wire terminates at the canopy at 20x); below-grade ghost stays restricted to foundation/floor-framing.

A4.note: Coordinator item 8 FAILED to land. Floors render in every room that has a slab, and the 'Ground floor is slab-on-grade — see Foundation for the slab and footings' note is present, but the new per-room check never fires: the panel shows only the 3 RO flags and the dedupe warning, no 'Room "..." has no floor slab under it'. Root cause in cae7943 src/framing/compute.ts: the room centroid for 'Living / Kitchen' (bbox -4..4 x -2.5..2.5) is exactly (0.00, 0.00), which is the CORNER vertex of slab 0..5.5 x 0..7.5, and the inPoly ray-cast counts a boundary point as inside, so slabCovered is true for all 6 rooms — including the phantom 8x5 room that has no slab under it. Fix: sample 4-5 interior points (centroid plus 0.25/0.75 bbox lerps) and/or treat on-edge hits as outside.

C5.note: Coordinator item 7 half-lands and introduces a worse defect. Good: 80-ish rows now fit ONE 'Schedules + takeoff' sheet (6 sheets total, no 97%-blank page 2). Bad: the red flag list OVERPRINTS the last takeoff row — 'Electrical · Circuit GEN-4 — 4 devices (15A / 14 AWG / 720 VA' and '⚑ RO shifted 54.5cm to fit the framed run' are drawn on top of each other and both are unreadable (20x crop /tmp/r3c-sched-collide.png). Deterministic arithmetic, not luck: rows step from y = MARGIN+24 = 72 by 15 px, so row 41 (maxLines = floor((816-96-76-24)/15) = 41) sits at y = 672, while the flag list is bottom-anchored at y = H-TITLE_H-40 = 700 minus 13 px per earlier flag, i.e. 674 for the first of 3 — 2 px from the row baseline. Any house with a full left column plus >= 1 flag collides. Fix: subtract ceil(flags/…)*13 from the usable height (or move flags to their own column/sheet). Still clipping mid-word at 62 chars too: '2x4 — 12 pcs (20 ft stock (field splice — run …', 'Mortar (Type S) — 51 bags (~20 blocks per 80-l…', 'GFCI receptacles — 25 pcs (NEC 210.8 wet locatio…', 'Nails 16d common — 25.9 lbs (3.5" — R602.3(1) sch…', and capacity is razor-thin (perSheet 82 vs ~80 rows) so one new row type re-splits the sheet.

topFixes: A1 — stop relying on the host to hide walls. Host mode 'down' assigns materials.invisible to every wall and that material is a dotted see-through ghost (wall-cutout.tsx hideWall/wallMode === 'down' + wall-materials.ts:480 createInvisibleWallMaterial), which is why the building reads as a translucent stipple box from eye level and cladding never appears from outside. Either add a host mode that truly skips the shell mesh (visible=false) and use it, or set the wall meshes invisible from the plugin, and keep the camera-facing cull to the INTERIOR stack only so exterior cladding survives on the far/outside faces.

C5 — reserve vertical space for the flag list on the schedules sheet: maxLines must be floor((H - 2*MARGIN - TITLE_H - 24 - flagBlockHeight)/lineH). Today row 41 (y 672) and flag 1 (y 674) overprint on every house with a full column plus a flag. While there, wrap rows to a second line instead of clipping at 62 chars, and leave headroom (perSheet 82 vs ~80 rows today).

A4 — make the per-room slab check actually fire: the centroid of 'Living / Kitchen' is exactly the slab corner (0,0) and the ray-cast counts boundary as inside, so all 6 rooms report covered and the phantom 8x5 room still gets no call-out. Sample several interior points and treat on-edge as uncovered.

C1 — wrap the code name at a space (not char 46) and give the title block a 4th line of room: the disclaimer is currently sliced by the block's bottom rule on all 6 sheets. Also populate the level name ('Pascal project — Level' has an empty right half).

C3/A5 — apply the 12 mm plane offset per CIRCUIT INDEX, not per hash: 4 pairs (SA-1/GEN-2, GEN-1/GEN-3, SA-2/BA-1, LTG-2/LTG-3) still share a plane and all 11 stack on the riser stub at (0.06,1.52,3.75). And shift the MEP context underlay by the legend gutter — the west wing footprint is erased under the legend box on the Plumbing + HVAC sheet.
